traits.name: False Object
traits.descriptionHtml: If the broom is motionless at the start of combat, it has advantage on its initiative roll. Moreover, if a creature hasn't observed the broom move or act, that creature must succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom (Perception) check to discern that the broom is animate.

traits.name: Flyby
traits.descriptionHtml: The broom doesn't provoke opportunity attacks when it flies out of an enemy's reach.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.descriptionHtml: The broom makes two melee attacks.

actions.name: Broomstick
actions.descriptionHtml: mw +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}5 (1d4 + 3) bludgeoning damage.

traits.descriptionHtml: If the library is motionless at the start of combat, it has advantage on its initiative roll. Moreover, if a creature hasn't observed the library move or act, that creature must succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom (Perception) check to discern that the library is animate.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.descriptionHtml: The library makes two attacks.

actions.name: Chained Book
actions.descriptionHtml: mw +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}6 (1d8 + 2) bludgeoning damage, and if the target is a creature, it is grappled (escape DC 12).

atWill.name: Light
atWill.components: V, M (a firefly or phosphorescent moss)

3e.name: Hold Monster
3e.components: V, S, M (a straight piece of iron)

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.descriptionHtml: Quill makes two attacks with his dagger and uses Supreme Mockery.

actions.name: Dagger
actions.descriptionHtml: mw,rw +8 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. {@h}6 (1d4 + 4) piercing damage.

actions.name: Quill's Fable {@recharge}
actions.descriptionHtml: Quill utters a short fable while targeting up to five creatures within 30 feet of him that he can see. Each target that can hear Quill's magical fable must make a DC 17 Wisdom saving throw, taking 36 (8d8) psychic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

actions.name: Supreme Mockery
actions.descriptionHtml: Quill hurls a string of insults laced with enchantments at a creature he can see within 60 feet of him. If the creature can hear Quill (though it need not understand him), it must succeed on a DC 17 Wisdom saving throw or take 66 (12d10) psychic damage and have disadvantage on the next attack roll it makes before the end of its next turn.

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (2/Day)
traits.descriptionHtml: If Bak Mei fails a saving throw, he can choose to succeed instead.

traits.name: Special Equipment

traits.name: Unarmored Defense
traits.descriptionHtml: While Bak Mei is wearing no armor and wielding no shield, his AC includes his Wisdom modifier.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.descriptionHtml: Bak Mei attacks three times: twice with Thunder Strike and once with his staff of striking.

actions.name: Thunder Strike
actions.descriptionHtml: mw +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}15 (2d10 + 4) thunder damage, and if the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 17 Constitution saving throw or be deafened and stunned until the start of Bak Mei's next turn.

actions.name: Staff of Striking
actions.descriptionHtml: mw +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}3 (1d6) bludgeoning damage, or 4 (1d8) bludgeoning damage when used with two hands, and Bak Mei can expend up to 3 of the staff's charges. For each expended charge, the target takes an extra 1d6 force damage.

actions.name: Heal Self (Recharges after a Long Rest)
actions.descriptionHtml: Bak Mei regains 2d8 + 4 hit points, and all levels of exhaustion end on him.

bonusActions.name: Nimble Escape
bonusActions.descriptionHtml: Bak Mei takes the Disengage or Hide action.

reactions.name: Deflect Missile
reactions.descriptionHtml: In response to being hit by a ranged weapon attack, Bak Mei deflects the missile. The damage he takes from the attack is reduced by 1d10 + 12. If the damage is reduced to 0, Bak Mei catches the missile if it's small enough to hold in one hand and Bak Mei has a hand free.

legendaryActions.description: The creature can take 3 legendary actions, choosing from the options below.

entries.name: Crane Dance
entries.descriptionHtml: Bak Mei moves up to 20 feet. This movement does not provoke opportunity attacks.

entries.name: Thunder Strike (Costs 2 Actions)
entries.descriptionHtml: Bak Mei uses Thunder Strike.

traits.name: Limited Spell Immunity
traits.descriptionHtml: The golem automatically succeeds on saving throws against spells of 7th level or lower, and the attack rolls of such spells always miss it.

traits.name: Unusual Nature
traits.descriptionHtml: The golem doesn't require air, food, drink, or sleep.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.descriptionHtml: The golem makes two attacks.

actions.name: Slam
actions.descriptionHtml: mw +10 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}27 (4d10 + 5) force damage.

actions.name: Crystal Dart
actions.descriptionHtml: rw +10 to hit, range 120 ft., one target. {@h}14 (2d8 + 5) force damage.

reactions.name: Spell Deflection
reactions.descriptionHtml: In response to a spell attack missing the golem, it causes that spell to hit another creature within 120 feet of it that it can see.

spellcasting.header: The chwinga's innate spellcasting ability is Wisdom. It can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material or verbal components:

atWill.name: Pass Without Trace
atWill.components: V, S, M (ashes from burned mistletoe)

traits.name: Unusual Nature
traits.descriptionHtml: The chwinga doesn't require air, food, or drink. When it dies, it turns into a handful of flower petals, a cloud of pollen, a stone statuette resembling its former self, a tiny sphere of smooth stone, or a puddle of fresh water (your choice).

traits.name: Evasion
traits.descriptionHtml: When the chwinga is subjected to an effect that allows it to make a Dexterity saving throw to take only half damage, it instead takes no damage if it succeeds on the saving throw, and only half damage if it fails.

actions.name: Magical Gift (1/Day)
actions.descriptionHtml: The chwinga targets a humanoid it can see within 5 feet of it. The target gains a supernatural charm of the DM's choice. See chapter 7 of the Dungeon Masters Guide for more information on supernatural charms.

actions.name: Natural Shelter
actions.descriptionHtml: The chwinga magically takes shelter inside a rock, a living plant, or a natural source of fresh water in its space. The chwinga can't be targeted by any attack, spell, or other effect while inside this shelter, and the shelter doesn't impair the chwinga's blindsight. The chwinga can use its action to emerge from a shelter. If its shelter is destroyed, the chwinga is forced out and appears in the shelter's space, but is otherwise unharmed.

legendaryActions.description: The creature can take 3 legendary actions, choosing from the options below.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
spellcasting.header: The ghost casts one of the following spells, using Charisma as the spellcasting ability and requiring no material components:

traits.name: Ethereal Sight
traits.descriptionHtml: The ghost can see 120 feet into the Ethereal Plane when it is on the Material Plane, and vice versa.

traits.name: Incorporeal Movement
traits.descriptionHtml: The ghost can move through other creatures and objects as if they were difficult terrain. It takes 5 (1d10) force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.

traits.name: Regeneration
traits.descriptionHtml: The ghost regains 10 hit points at the start of its turn. If the ghost takes radiant damage or damage from a magic weapon, this trait doesn't function at the start of the ghost's next turn. The ghost dies only if it starts its turn with 0 hit points and doesn't regenerate.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.descriptionHtml: The ghost makes two melee attacks.

actions.name: Spectral Weapon
actions.descriptionHtml: mw +12 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}21 (3d8 + 8) force damage.

actions.name: Etherealness
actions.descriptionHtml: The ghost enters the Ethereal Plane from the Material Plane, or vice versa. It is visible on the Material Plane while it is in the Border Ethereal, and vice versa, yet it can't affect or be affected by anything on the other plane.

actions.name: Wind Howl {@recharge}
actions.descriptionHtml: The ghost emits a dreadful howl that summons a cold, biting wind. This wind engulfs up to three creatures of the ghost's choice that it can see within 60 feet of it. Each target is pulled up to 20 feet toward the ghost and must make a DC 15 Constitution saving throw, taking 16 (3d10) cold damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

legendaryActions.description: The creature can take 3 legendary actions, choosing from the options below.

traits.name: Unusual Nature
traits.descriptionHtml: The commoner doesn't require air, food, drink, or sleep, and it gains no benefit from finishing a short or long rest. When it drops to 0 hit points, it becomes a lifeless object.

actions.name: Club
actions.descriptionHtml: mw +2 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}2 (1d4) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Hooves
actions.descriptionHtml: mw +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}32 (8d6 + 4) necrotic damage.

actions.name: Horn
actions.descriptionHtml: mw +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}32 (8d6 + 4) necrotic damage. If the target is a humanoid, it must succeed on a DC 13 Wisdom saving throw or be transformed into a wolf under the avatar's control. This transformation lasts for 1 hour, or until the target drops to 0 hit points or dies. The target's game statistics are replaced by the wolf's statistics, but it retains its hit points. The target is limited in the actions it can perform by the nature of its wolf form, and it can't speak, cast spells, or take any other action that requires hands or speech. The target's gear melds into the new form, and it can't activate, use, wield, or otherwise benefit from any of its equipment.

traits.descriptionHtml: The dragon turtle can breathe air and water.

actions.descriptionHtml: The dragon turtle makes three attacks: one with its bite and two with its claws. It can make one tail attack in place of its two claw attacks.

actions.name: Bite
actions.descriptionHtml: mw +13 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. {@h}26 (3d12 + 7) piercing damage.

actions.name: Claw
actions.descriptionHtml: mw +13 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}16 (2d8 + 7) slashing damage.

actions.name: Tail
actions.descriptionHtml: mw +13 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. {@h}26 (3d12 + 7) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 20 Strength saving throw or be pushed up to 10 feet away from the dragon turtle and knocked prone.

actions.name: Steam Breath (Recharge 5)
actions.descriptionHtml: The dragon turtle exhales scalding steam in a 60-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a DC 18 Constitution saving throw, taking 52 (15d6) fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. Being underwater doesn't grant resistance against this damage.

reactions.name: Parry

name: Fungal Servant
languages: The languages it knew in life

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
spellcasting.header: The fungal servant is a 10th-level spellcaster. Its spellcasting ability is Wisdom (spell save DC 17, +9 to hit with spell attacks). The fungal servant has the following cleric spells prepared:

spells.name: Hold Person
spells.components: V, S, M (a straight piece of iron)

spells.name: Animate Dead
spells.components: V, S, M (a drop of blood, a piece of flesh, and a pinch of bone dust)

spells.name: Divination
spells.components: V, S, M (incense worth 25+ GP, which the spell consumes)

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.descriptionHtml: The fungal servant has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Rejuvenation
traits.descriptionHtml: A destroyed fungal servant gains a new body in 24 hours if its heart is intact, regaining all its hit points and becoming active again. The new body appears within 5 feet of the fungal servant's heart.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.descriptionHtml: The fungal servant can use its Dreadful Glare and makes one attack with its rotting fist.

actions.name: Rotting Fist
actions.descriptionHtml: mw +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}14 (3d6 + 4) bludgeoning damage plus 21 (6d6) necrotic damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 16 Constitution saving throw or be cursed with mummy rot. The cursed target can't regain hit points, and its hit point maximum decreases by 10 (3d6) for every 24 hours that elapse. If the curse reduces the target's hit point maximum to 0, the target dies, and its body turns to spores. The curse lasts until removed by the remove curse spell or other magic.

actions.name: Dreadful Glare
actions.descriptionHtml: The fungal servant targets one creature it can see within 60 feet of it. If the target can see the fungal servant, it must succeed on a DC 16 Wisdom saving throw against this magic or become frightened until the end of the fungal servant's next turn. If the target fails the saving throw by 5 or more, it is also paralyzed for the same duration. A target that succeeds on the saving throw is immune to the Dreadful Glare of all fungal servants for the next 24 hours.

legendaryActions.description: The creature can take 3 legendary actions, choosing from the options below.

entries.name: Attack
entries.descriptionHtml: The fungal servant makes one attack with its rotting fist or uses its Dreadful Glare.

entries.name: Blinding Spores
entries.descriptionHtml: Blinding spores swirls magically around the fungal servant. Each creature within 5 feet of the fungal servant must succeed on a DC 16 Constitution saving throw or be blinded until the end of the creature's next turn.

entries.name: Blasphemous Word (Costs 2 Actions)
entries.descriptionHtml: The fungal servant utters a blasphemous word. Each non-undead creature within 10 feet of the fungal servant that can hear the magical utterance must succeed on a DC 16 Constitution saving throw or be stunned until the end of the fungal servant's next turn.

entries.name: Channel Negative Energy (Costs 2 Actions)
entries.descriptionHtml: The fungal servant magically unleashes negative energy. Creatures within 60 feet of the fungal servant, including ones behind barriers and around corners, can't regain hit points until the end of the fungal servant's next turn.

entries.name: Whirlwind of Spores (Costs 2 Actions)
entries.descriptionHtml: The fungal servant magically transforms into a whirlwind of spores, moves up to 60 feet, and reverts to its normal form. While in whirlwind form, the fungal servant is immune to all damage, and it can't be grappled, petrified, knocked prone, restrained, or stunned. Equipment worn or carried by the fungal servant remain in its possession.

traits.name: Alternate Forms
traits.descriptionHtml: The gingwatzim has two alternate forms, both of which are chosen by its creator when the gingwatzim comes into being. One form is an exact duplicate of a Tiny nonmagical object (such as a book, dagger, or gemstone) that its creator is carrying or wearing when the gingwatzim is conjured. The other form can be any Tiny beast. Once these alternate forms are chosen, they can't be changed.

actions.name: Energy Drain (True Form Only)
actions.descriptionHtml: mw +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. {@h}16 (4d6 + 2) necrotic damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 12 Constitution saving throw or gain 1 level of exhaustion. When the target finishes a short or long rest, the target loses every level of exhaustion gained from this attack.

actions.name: Change Shape
actions.descriptionHtml: The gingwatzim changes from its true form—a 3-foot-diameter sphere of luminous ectoplasm—into one of its two alternate forms, or from one of those forms back into its true form. In object form, it can't move or make attacks but otherwise retains its statistics, and it is indistinguishable from the thing it is imitating. In beast form, it retains its hit points but otherwise uses the stat block of the beast it is imitating. When it dies, the gingwatzim reverts to its true form and then vanishes.

traits.name: Standing Leap
traits.descriptionHtml: The grippli can leap 30 feet horizontally or 20 feet vertically from a standing position.

actions.descriptionHtml: The grippli makes one attack with its tongue. If this attack hits, the grippli can make a melee attack using its trident against the same target.

actions.name: Tongue
actions.descriptionHtml: mw +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one Medium or smaller creature. {@h}The target is grappled (escape DC 12). Until this grapple ends, the target is restrained, and the grippli can't grab another creature.

actions.name: Trident
actions.descriptionHtml: mw,rw +4 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. {@h}5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage, or 6 (1d8 + 2) piercing damage if used with two hands to make a melee attack, plus 2 (1d4) piercing damage if the grippli had advantage on the attack roll.

actions.name: Shortbow
actions.descriptionHtml: rw +4 to hit, range 80/320 ft., one target. {@h}5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage, plus 2 (1d4) piercing damage if the grippli had advantage on the attack roll.

spellcasting.name: Innate Spellcasting

atWill.name: Dancing Lights
atWill.components: V, S, M (a bit of phosphorus)

traits.name: Amphibious
traits.descriptionHtml: The hag can breathe air and water.

traits.name: Mimicry
traits.descriptionHtml: The hag can mimic animal sounds and humanoid voices. A creature that hears the sounds can tell they are imitations with a successful DC 14 Wisdom (Insight) check.

actions.name: Claws
actions.descriptionHtml: mw +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}13 (2d8 + 4) slashing damage.

actions.name: Illusory Appearance
actions.descriptionHtml:
The hag covers herself and anything she is wearing or carrying with a magical illusion that makes her look like another creature of her general size and humanoid shape. The illusion ends if the hag takes a bonus action to end it or if she dies.

The changes wrought by this effect fail to hold up to physical inspection. For example, the hag could appear to have smooth skin, but someone touching her would feel her rough flesh. Otherwise, a creature must take an action to visually inspect the illusion and succeed on a DC 20 Intelligence (Investigation) check to discern that the hag is disguised.

actions.name: Invisible Passage
actions.descriptionHtml: The hag magically turns invisible until she attacks or casts a spell, or until her concentration ends (as if concentration on a spell). While invisible, she leaves no physical evidence of her passage, so she can be tracked only by magic. Any equipment she wears or carries is invisible with her.

actions.name: Poisoned Dart
actions.descriptionHtml: rw +5 to hit, range 20/60 ft., one target. {@h}4 (1d4 + 2) piercing damage plus 7 (3d4) poison damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or gain 1 level of exhaustion.

actions.name: Heal Self (Recharges after a Long Rest)
actions.descriptionHtml: Jade Tigress regains 2d8 + 2 hit points, and all levels of exhaustion end on her.

bonusActions.name: Nimble Escape
bonusActions.descriptionHtml: Jade Tigress takes the Disengage or Hide action.

reactions.name: Deflect Missile

If the damage is reduced to 0, Jade Tigress catches the missile if it's small enough to hold in one hand and Jade Tigress has a hand free.

spells.components: V, S, M (a morsel of food)

spells.name: Barkskin
spells.components: V, S, M (a handful of oak bark)

traits.name: Feline Agility
traits.descriptionHtml: When K'Tulah moves on her turn in combat, she can double her speed until the end of the turn. Once she uses this ability, K'Tulah can't use it again until she moves 0 feet on one of her turns.

actions.name: Quarterstaff
actions.descriptionHtml: mw +2 to hit (+4 to hit with shillelagh), reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}3 (1d6) bludgeoning damage, 4 (1d8) bludgeoning damage if wielded with two hands, or 6 (1d8 + 2) bludgeoning damage with shillelagh.

actions.descriptionHtml: mw +2 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}2 (1d4) slashing damage.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
spellcasting.header: The lich casts one of the following spells using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability (save DC 19):

3e.name: Pass Without Trace
3e.components: V, S, M (ashes from burned mistletoe)

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
traits.descriptionHtml: If the lich fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

traits.name: Rejuvenation
traits.descriptionHtml: If it has a phylactery, a destroyed lich gains a new body in 1d10 days, regaining all its hit points and becoming active again. The new body appears within 5 feet of the phylactery.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.descriptionHtml: The lich makes four attacks.

actions.name: Poisonous Touch
actions.descriptionHtml: mw +9 to hit, reach 10 ft., one creature. {@h}17 (5d6) poison damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 19 Constitution saving throw or be poisoned for 1 minute. The target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

actions.name: Wither
actions.descriptionHtml: rs +9 to hit, range 60 ft., one target. {@h}14 (4d6) necrotic damage.

actions.name: Fire Storm (7th-Level Spell; 1/Day)
actions.descriptionHtml: The lich fills up to ten 10-foot cubes with fire. Every cube must be within 150 feet of the lich and occupy a space the lich can see, and each cube must have at least one face adjacent to the face of another cube. Each creature in the area must make a DC 19 Dexterity saving throw, taking 38 (7d10) fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. The fire ignites flammable objects in the area that aren't being worn or carried. If the lich chooses, plant life in the area is unaffected by the spell.

legendaryActions.description: The creature can take 3 legendary actions, choosing from the options below.

entries.name: Attack
entries.descriptionHtml: The lich makes an attack.

entries.name: Poison Prick (Cost 2 Actions)
entries.descriptionHtml: The lich targets one poisoned creature it can see within 30 feet of it. The target must succeed on a DC 19 Constitution saving throw or fall unconscious until the poisoned condition ends on it.

entries.name: Sap Life (Costs 2 Actions)
entries.descriptionHtml: The lich targets one creature it can see within 30 feet of it. The target must succeed on a DC 19 Constitution saving throw or take 11 (2d10) necrotic damage. The lich regains a number of hit points equal to the amount of damage that the creature takes.

lairActions.name: Lair Action
lairActions.descriptionHtml: Poisonous spores fill a 10-foot cube that the lich can see within 120 feet of it. Any creature that enters the cloud for the first time on a turn or starts its turn there must succeed on a DC 19 Constitution saving throw or be poisoned until the end of its next turn. The cloud lasts for 1 minute or until it is dispersed by a strong wind.

lairActions.name: Lair Action
lairActions.descriptionHtml: The lich commands the might of its diseased grove, creating a shambling mound. The shambling mound appears in an unoccupied space within 30 feet of the lich, acts on its own initiative count, and obeys the lich's commands. The shambling mound dies after 1 hour or when the lich uses this lair action again.

lairActions.name: Lair Action
lairActions.descriptionHtml: Rotten roots and vines magically erupt in a 20-foot radius centered on a point on the ground that the lich can see within 120 feet of it. The lich is unaffected by the roots and vines. For all other creatures, the area becomes difficult terrain, and each creature in the area must succeed on a DC 19 Strength saving throw or be restrained by the roots. As an action, a creature can try to free itself or another creature within its reach, doing so with a successful DC 19 Strength (Athletics) check. The roots and vines wilt away when the lich uses this lair action again or when the lich dies.

name: Lightning Golem

immune.note: from nonmagical attacks that aren't adamantine

languages: understands the languages of its creator but can't speak

traits.name: Berserk
traits.descriptionHtml:
Whenever the golem starts its turn with 40 hit points or fewer, roll a d6. On a 6, the golem goes berserk. On each of its turns while berserk, the golem attacks the nearest creature it can see. If no creature is near enough to move to and attack, the golem attacks an object, with preference for an object smaller than itself. Once the golem goes berserk, it continues to do so until it is destroyed or regains all its hit points.

The golem's creator, if within 60 feet of the berserk golem, can try to calm it by speaking firmly and persuasively. reactions.name: Parry
reactions.descriptionHtml: Varnyr adds 2 to their AC against one melee attack that would hit it. To do so, Varnyr must see the attacker and be wielding a melee weapon.

legendaryActions.description: The creature can take 3 legendary actions, choosing from the options below.

spellcasting.name: Innate Spellcasting
spellcasting.header: The drow's spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 12). It can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components:

atWill.name: Dancing Lights
atWill.components: V, S, M (a bit of phosphorus)

1e.name: Darkness
1e.components: V, M (bat fur and a piece of coal)

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
spellcasting.header: The drow is a 10th-level spellcaster. Its spellcasting ability is Intelligence (spell save DC 14, +6 to hit with spell attacks). The drow has the following wizard spells prepared:

spells.name: Mage Armor
spells.components: V, S, M (a piece of cured leather)

spells.name: Shield
spells.castingTime: 1 reaction (which you take when you are hit by an attack roll or targeted by the Magic Missile spell)

spells.name: Witch Bolt
spells.components: V, S, M (a twig struck by lightning)

spells.name: Web
spells.components: V, S, M (a bit of spiderweb)

spells.name: Lightning Bolt
spells.components: V, S, M (a bit of fur and a crystal rod)

traits.name: Fey Ancestry
traits.descriptionHtml: The drow has advantage on saving throws against being charmed, and magic can't put the drow to sleep.

traits.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
traits.descriptionHtml: While in sunlight, the drow has disadvantage on attack rolls, as well as on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight.

actions.name: Staff
actions.descriptionHtml: mw +2 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}2 (1d6 - 1) bludgeoning damage, or 3 (1d8 - 1) bludgeoning damage if used with two hands, plus 3 (1d6) poison damage.

actions.name: Summon Demon (1/Day)
actions.descriptionHtml: The drow magically summons a quasit, or attempts to summon a shadow demon with a 50% chance of success. The summoned demon appears in an unoccupied space within 60 feet of its summoner, acts as an ally of its summoner, and can't summon other demons. It remains for 10 minutes, until it or its summoner dies, or until its summoner dismisses it as an action.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
spellcasting.header: The archmage is an 18th-level spellcaster. Its spellcasting ability is Intelligence (spell save DC 17, +9 to hit with spell attacks). The archmage can cast disguise self and invisibility at will and has the following wizard spells prepared:
spellcasting.footer: *The archmage casts these spells on itself before combat.

spells.name: Light
spells.components: V, M (a firefly or phosphorescent moss)

spells.name: Identify
spells.components: V, S, M (a pearl worth 100+ GP)

spells.name: Mage Armor
spells.components: V, S, M (a piece of cured leather)

spells.name: Counterspell
spells.castingTime: 1 reaction (which you take when you see a creature within 60 feet of yourself casting a spell with Verbal, Somatic, or Material components)

spells.name: Lightning Bolt
spells.components: V, S, M (a bit of fur and a crystal rod)

spells.name: Fire Shield
spells.components: V, S, M (a bit of phosphorus or a firefly)

spells.name: Stoneskin
spells.components: V, S, M (diamond dust worth 100+ GP, which the spell consumes)

spells.name: Cone of Cold
spells.components: V, S, M (a small crystal or glass cone)

spells.name: Scrying
spells.components: V, S, M (a focus worth 1,000+ GP, such as a crystal ball, mirror, or water-filled font)

spells.name: Wall of Force
spells.components: V, S, M (a shard of glass)

atWill.name: Invisibility
atWill.components: V, S, M (an eyelash in gum arabic)

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.descriptionHtml: The archmage has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Dagger
actions.descriptionHtml: mw,rw +6 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. {@h}4 (1d4 + 2) piercing damage.

legendaryActions.description: The creature can take 3 legendary actions, choosing from the options below.

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
traits.descriptionHtml: If Zikzokrishka fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.descriptionHtml: Zikzokrishka has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.descriptionHtml: Zikzokrishka can use its Frightful Presence. It then makes three attacks: one with its bite and two with its claws.

actions.name: Bite
actions.descriptionHtml: mw +13 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}18 (2d10 + 7) piercing damage plus 5 (1d10) lightning damage.

actions.name: Claw
actions.descriptionHtml: mw +13 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}14 (2d6 + 7) slashing damage.

actions.name: Tail
actions.descriptionHtml: mw +13 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. {@h}16 (2d8 + 7) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Frightful Presence
actions.descriptionHtml: Each creature of Zikzokrishka's choice that is within 120 feet of the Zikzokrishka and aware of it must succeed on a DC 18 Wisdom saving throw or become frightened for 1 minute. A creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. If a creature's saving throw is successful or the effect ends for it, the creature is immune to the Zikzokrishka's Frightful Presence for the next 24 hours.

actions.name: Lightning Breath (Recharge 5)
actions.descriptionHtml: Zikzokrishka exhales lightning in a 90-foot line that is 5 feet wide. Each creature in that line must make a DC 20 Dexterity saving throw, taking 66 (12d10) lightning damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

legendaryActions.description: The creature can take 3 legendary actions, choosing from the options below.

entries.name: Detect
entries.descriptionHtml: Zikzokrishka makes a Wisdom (Perception) check.

entries.name: Tail Attack
entries.descriptionHtml: Zikzokrishka makes a tail attack.

entries.name: Wing Attack (Costs 2 Actions)
entries.descriptionHtml: Zikzokrishka beats its tattered wings. Each creature within 10 feet of Zikzokrishka must succeed on a DC 21 Dexterity saving throw or take 14 (2d6 + 7) bludgeoning damage and be knocked prone. After beating its wings this way, Zikzokrishka can fly up to half its flying speed.

lairActions.name: Lair Action
lairActions.descriptionHtml: Part of the ceiling collapses above one creature that Zikzokrishka can see. The creature must succeed on a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw or take 21 (6d6) bludgeoning damage and be knocked prone and buried under rubble. A buried creature is restrained and unable to stand up. A creature can use an action to try to pull itself or another creature out of the rubble, doing so with a successful DC 10 Strength (Athletics) check.

lairActions.name: Lair Action
lairActions.descriptionHtml: A cloud of sand swirls in a 20-foot-radius sphere centered on a point Zikzokrishka can see within 60 feet of it. The cloud spreads around corners. Each creature in the cloud must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or be blinded for 1 minute. A creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

lairActions.name: Lair Action
lairActions.descriptionHtml: Zikzokrishka chooses two points that it can see, each of which must be on a solid surface, and creates a 5-foot-wide line of lightning between them. The two points must be within 60 feet of Zikzokrishka and 60 feet of each other. Each creature in the line must succeed on a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw or take 10 (3d6) lightning damage.
